measurement: Per-pixel maximum absolute RGB-channel error, ICC-managed linear Display-P3, white = 1; not Delta E
source: All values in this report come from actual public-API renders, not numerical model predictions.
limitations: Photographic validation repeatedly uses the same scene.
Color-scene negative Highlights and negative Shadows regress against Core Image.
Strong positive Whites retains a large residual.
The A10 comparison excludes grain and other unsupported stages in both versions.
The final finite-value clamping fix leaves the tested normal-range values unchanged.
